summary: Open-source project management platform serving as an alternative to Jira, Linear, Monday, and ClickUp, enabling task, sprint, doc, and triage management.
usecases: Team task and sprint tracking for software development projects.
Centralized documentation and triage management within projects.
Customizable workflows for product management and bug tracking.
ideas: Integrate with CI/CD pipelines for automatic issue linking on deployments.
Build a mobile app companion for on-the-go task management.
Add AI-powered task prioritization and suggestion features.
